adjust_grenades.summary: Modifies a player's grenade count by type using a math operation.

params.math_operation: How to apply the value (set_to, add, subtract, …).

apply_player_traits.summary: Applies a named `player_traits` block to a player.

begin.summary: Marks the start of a nested sub-trigger block. While `begin` is technically an action, the language treats it more like an element. See the begin element page for more information.

biped_drop_weapon.summary: Drops a weapon from a biped/player.

params.biped: Object or player that receives or drops the weapon.

biped_give_weapon.summary: Gives a weapon to a biped/player.

params.biped: Object or player that receives the weapon.
params.weapon: Weapon type from the weapons object list (usually written in quotes).
params.mode: Equip mode: primary, secondary, or force.

boundary_set_player_color.summary: Sets boundary tint color for a player.

params.player_variable_name: Player member variable on the object.

boundary_set_visible.summary: Shows or hides a boundary volume.

params.boolean: true / false, or a boolean-like value.

break_into_debugger.summary: Breaks into the script debugger when tracing is enabled.

create_object.summary: Spawns an object of the given type, optionally placed and labeled.

params.object_type: Quoted type from the objects object list.
params.set: Optional object variable that receives the created instance.

create_tunnel.summary: Places an object between two entities and gives that object a **cylinder** shape. The radius comes from the radius operand; if that value is **0**, the engine uses **5** instead. If both endpoints are the same object, the tunnel is placed **exactly** on that reference—there is no collision check, unlike create_object. The spawned object also faces straight up.

params.object_type: Quoted type from the objects object list.
params.object_reference_out: Object variable that receives the created instance.

debugging_enable_tracing.summary: Enables or disables script tracing in the debugger.

debug_force_player_view_count.summary: Debug action to force player view count.

delete_object.summary: Removes an object reference from the map.

device_animate_position.summary: Animates a device between positions over time.

device_get_position.summary: Reads device position into an out-variable.

params.number_out: Number variable that receives a percent value.

device_get_power.summary: Reads device power into an out-variable.

params.number_out: Number variable that receives a percent value.

device_set_position_immediate.summary: Snaps a device to a position without animation.

device_set_position_track.summary: Assigns an animation track name to a device.

for_each.summary: Iterates over players, teams, or objects and runs nested trigger logic.

game_grief_record_custom_penalty.summary: Records a custom grief report penalty value.

get_button_time.summary: Reads how long a scriptable button was held into a custom variable, in milliseconds (Reach MCC only).

params.milliseconds_out: Number variable that receives milliseconds held.

get_player_holding_object.summary: Writes the player holding an object into an out-variable.

params.player_out: Player variable that receives the result.

get_random_object.summary: Selects a random object matching criteria and writes it to an out-variable.

params.ignore_object: Object to exclude from the random pick.
params.object_out: Object variable that receives the result.

give_weapon.summary: Gives a weapon to a player (legacy / partial availability; prefer biped_give_weapon).

params.mode: Equip / slot mode: primary, secondary, force.

hide_object.summary: Hides or shows an object for players (Reach MCC only).

params.should_hide: Whether the object should be hidden.

hs_function_call.summary: Calls a HaloScript function by index (Reach MCC only).

hud_post_message.summary: Posts a HUD message to a team or player target. The sound operand selects an e_megalo_sound token or `none`. The message is a dynamic string.

params.team_or_player_target: everyone, or a specific player / team.
params.sound: Sound name from the sounds object list.
params.dynamic_string: Quoted string or dynamic string expression.

hud_widget_set_icon.summary: Sets the icon on a HUD widget.

params.hud_widget_name: Name of a hud_widget declared in the script.

hud_widget_set_meter.summary: Configures meter parameters on a HUD widget.

params.hud_widget_name: Name of a hud_widget declared in the script.
params.meter: Meter mode: off, two numbers, or a timer.

hud_widget_set_text.summary: Updates text on a named HUD widget using a dynamic string.

params.hud_widget_name: Name of a hud_widget declared in the script.
params.dynamic_string: Quoted string or dynamic string expression.

hud_widget_set_value.summary: Updates a numeric value displayed on a HUD widget using a dynamic string.

params.hud_widget_name: Name of a hud_widget declared in the script.
params.dynamic_string: Quoted string or dynamic string expression.

hud_widget_set_visibility.summary: Shows or hides a HUD widget for a player reference.

params.hud_widget_name: Name of a hud_widget declared in the script.

navpoint_set_icon.summary: Sets the navpoint icon displayed above an object. The ME name table ends with `coop spawning` (space). MegaloEdit cannot parse it (Megalo Headache #3); enable MegaCrow’s `coopSpawning` extension to accept the two-token form.

params.number: Numeric icon value when icon is num.

navpoint_set_text.summary: Sets navpoint label text from a dynamic string.

params.dynamic_string: Quoted string or dynamic string expression.

navpoint_set_timer.summary: Links a navpoint to a timer for countdown display.

navpoint_set_visible.summary: Controls navpoint visibility for a target audience (everyone, team, player, etc.).

params.audience: Who is affected: no_one, everyone, allies, enemies, player (player form may take a player and boolean).

navpoint_set_visible_range.summary: Sets the distance at which a navpoint becomes visible.

object_adjust_health.summary: Modifies an object's current health with a math operation.

params.math_operation: How to apply the value (set_to, add, subtract, …).

object_adjust_maximum_health.summary: Modifies an object's maximum health with a math operation.

params.math_operation: How to apply the value (set_to, add, subtract, …).

object_adjust_maximum_shield.summary: Modifies an object's maximum shields with a math operation.

params.math_operation: How to apply the value (set_to, add, subtract, …).

object_adjust_shield.summary: Modifies an object's current shields with a math operation.

params.math_operation: How to apply the value (set_to, add, subtract, …).

object_attach.summary: Attaches one object to another with offset and constraint parameters.

object_bounce.summary: Applies an upward impulse to an object.

object_destroy.summary: Destroys an object immediately (distinct from `delete_object` in engine handling).

object_detach.summary: Detaches a child object from its parent.

object_face_object.summary: Rotates an object to face another object.

object_get_distance.summary: Writes the distance between two objects into an out-variable.

params.distance_out: Number variable that receives distance in feet.

object_get_health.summary: Reads an object's current health into an out-variable.

params.vitality_out: Number variable that receives vitality percent.

object_get_orientation.summary: Reads an object's orientation into an out-variable.

object_get_shield.summary: Reads an object's current shields into an out-variable.

params.vitality_out: Number variable that receives vitality percent.

object_get_velocity.summary: Reads an object's velocity into an out-variable.

object_set_invincibility.summary: Sets whether an object can take damage.

params.boolean: true / false, or a boolean-like value.

object_set_minimap_icon.summary: Sets an object's minimap icon. Compiles on Alpha Reach builds, but no known Reach build renders a working minimap.

object_set_minimap_priority.summary: Sets an object's minimap priority. Compiles on Alpha Reach builds, but no known Reach build renders a working minimap.

object_set_minimap_visibility.summary: Shows or hides an object on the minimap. Compiles on Alpha Reach builds, but no known Reach build renders a working minimap.

params.boolean: true / false, or a boolean-like value.

object_set_never_garbage.summary: Prevents the engine from garbage-collecting an object.

params.boolean: true / false, or a boolean-like value.

object_set_scale.summary: Scales an object by a multiplier.

player_adjust_money.summary: Modifies a player's requisition money with a math operation. `player_adjust_money` is part of the Requisition System that was scrapped before Halo: Reach's release. While much of the requisition functionality remains in the game to this day, the requisition menu is long gone, rendering this action effectively useless outside of early pre-release builds.

params.math_operation: How to apply the value (set_to, add, subtract, …).

player_death_get_damage_type.summary: Writes the damage type from a death event into an out-variable.

params.number_out: Number variable that receives the damage type.

player_death_get_killing_player.summary: Writes the killing player from a death event into an out-variable.

params.killing_player: Player variable that receives the killer.

player_death_get_special_type.summary: Writes the special death type (melee, headshot, etc.) into an out-variable.

params.number_out: Number variable that receives the special death type.

player_enable_purchases.summary: Enables or disables requisition purchases by category and alive/dead state. `player_enable_purchases` is part of the Requisition System that was scrapped before Halo: Reach's release. While much of the requisition functionality remains in the game to this day, the requisition menu is long gone, rendering this action effectively useless outside of early pre-release builds.

params.when: When purchases apply: alive, dead, both.
params.boolean: true / false, or a boolean-like value.

player_get_equipment.summary: Reads a player's equipment into an out-variable.

params.equipment_out: Object variable that receives the equipment.

player_get_fireteam_index.summary: Reads or writes a player's fireteam index.

params.number_out: Number variable that receives the result.

player_get_killing_spree_count.summary: Reads a player's killstreak count into an out-variable.

params.number_out: Number variable that receives the result.

player_get_place.summary: Writes a player's scoreboard rank into an out-variable.

player_get_target_object.summary: Reads a player's current target object into an out-variable.

params.object_out: Object variable that receives the result.

player_get_vehicle.summary: Writes the vehicle a player occupies into an out-variable.

params.vehicle_out: Object variable that receives the vehicle.

player_get_weapon.summary: Reads a player's current weapon into an out-variable.

params.weapon_out: Object variable that receives the weapon.

player_pick_up_weapon.summary: Forces a player to pick up a weapon object.

player_set_coop_spawning.summary: Enables or disables cooperative spawning for a player.

player_set_fireteam_index.summary: Assigns a player to a fireteam index.

player_set_objective.summary: Sets objective text shown to a player using a dynamic string.

params.dynamic_string: Quoted string or dynamic string expression.

player_set_objective_allegiance.summary: Sets objective allegiance text (friendly/enemy/neutral styling) using a dynamic string.

params.dynamic_string: Quoted string or dynamic string expression.

player_set_objective_allegiance_icon.summary: Sets the objective allegiance icon for a player. The icon is a constant integer (literal or number constant such as `k_engine_icon_elite`), in range `0`–`127`, or `-1` for none.

player_set_primary_respawn_object.summary: Sets a player's primary respawn object.

player_set_requisition_palette.summary: Assigns a requisition palette to a player. `player_set_requisition_palette` is part of the Requisition System that was scrapped before Halo: Reach's release. While much of the requisition functionality remains in the game to this day, the requisition menu is long gone, rendering this action effectively useless outside of early pre-release builds.

player_set_unit.summary: Megalo action `player_set_unit` with operands: player, object.

player_set_vehicle.summary: Forces a player into a vehicle reference.

player_set_vehicle_spawning.summary: Enables or disables vehicle spawning for a player.

play_sound.summary: Plays a sound for a team or player target. Sound tokens are listed in Sounds.

params.team_or_player_target: everyone, or a specific player / team.
params.sound: Sound name from the sounds object list.

print_variable.summary: Prints a dynamic string to the debug log.

params.dynamic_string: Quoted string or dynamic string expression.

random.summary: Writes a random integer into an out-variable between the configured minimum and maximum. The minimum is **inclusive**; the maximum is **exclusive** (for example, `action random 0 5 x` yields 0–4).

params.number_out: Number variable that receives the random result.

respawn_zone_enable.summary: Enables or disables a respawn zone object.

params.boolean: true / false, or a boolean-like value.

saved_film_insert_marker.summary: Inserts a marker into a saved film recording. The label operand is a dynamic string.

set.summary: Modifies a variable using a math operation (`set_to`, `add`, `subtract`, `multiply`, `divide`, `modulo`, or `=`). The target can be a custom variable, member variable, or built-in global.

params.math_operation: How to apply the value (set_to, add, subtract, …).

set_boundary.summary: Configures boundary shape parameters on an object.

params.shape: Boundary shape: none, sphere, cylinder, box.

set_fireteam_respawn_filter.summary: Restricts fireteam respawn permissions on an object.

set_loadout.summary: Assigns a named loadout to a player.

set_loadout_palette.summary: Assigns a loadout palette tier to a player or team. By default, the `loadout_selection_time` game option is set to zero. Using `set_loadout_palette` will set `loadout_selection_time`to 10 if: - You are not using the `base` element - ie. your script doesnt use `base "../file.mglo"` - You haven't set `loadout_selection_time` in your `game_options`.

set_pickup_filter.summary: Restricts who can pick up an object (`all`, `allies`, `enemies`, `no_one`).

params.audience: Who is affected: no_one, everyone, allies, enemies, player (player form may take a player and boolean).

set_player_respawn_vehicle.summary: Sets the respawn vehicle type for a player (Reach MCC only).

set_progress_bar.summary: Configures an object's progress bar display.

params.audience: Who is affected: no_one, everyone, allies, enemies, player (player form may take a player and boolean).

set_respawn_filter.summary: Restricts who can respawn at an object.

params.audience: Who is affected: no_one, everyone, allies, enemies, player (player form may take a player and boolean).

set_scenario_interpolator_state.summary: Sets a scenario interpolator state index.

set_score.summary: Changes score for a player, team, or everyone using a math operation.

params.math_operation: How to apply the value (set_to, add, …).
params.target: everyone, or a specific player / team.

set_team_respawn_vehicle.summary: Sets the respawn vehicle type for a team (Reach MCC only).

submit_incident.summary: Fires a game incident with team or player target context for cause and effect (from `incidents.txt`).

params.incident_name: Incident name from the incidents object list.
params.cause_team_or_player: Cause side: everyone, or a specific player / team.
params.effect_team_or_player: Effect side: everyone, or a specific player / team.

submit_incident_with_custom_value.summary: Fires a game incident and passes a custom numeric value.

params.incident_name: Incident name from the incidents object list.
params.cause_team_or_player: Cause side: everyone, or a specific player / team.
params.effect_team_or_player: Effect side: everyone, or a specific player / team.

team_get_place.summary: Writes a team's scoreboard rank into an out-variable.

team_set_coop_spawning.summary: Enables or disables cooperative spawning for a team.

team_set_primary_respawn_object.summary: Sets a team's primary respawn object.

team_set_vehicle_spawning.summary: Enables or disables vehicle spawning for a team (Reach MCC only).

timer_reset.summary: Resets a timer to its initial value.

timer_set_rate.summary: Sets a timer's tick rate. `0` pauses, `-1` counts down, `1` is normal speed.

weapon_set_pickup_priority.summary: Sets weapon pickup priority for an object.

object_is_type.summary: True when an object matches the given object-list type.

params.object_type: Quoted name from the objects object list.

if.summary: Compares two values with a numeric comparison operator.

object_in_area.summary: True when an object is inside another object's area/boundary.

player_died.summary: True when a player died by a matching killer type.

team_disposition.summary: Tests the disposition relationship between two teams.

timer_expired.summary: True when the given timer has reached zero / expired.

team_is_active.summary: True when the team is currently active in the match.

object_out_of_bounds.summary: True when an object is outside the playable map bounds.

player_is_fire_team_leader.summary: True when the player is the leader of their fireteam.

player_assisted_with_kill.summary: True when the player assisted with the current kill event.

object_matches_filter.summary: True when an object matches a named object filter / label.

player_is_active.summary: True when the player is currently active in the round.

equipment_is_active.summary: True when the player's equipment ability is active.

player_is_spartan.summary: True when the player is using the Spartan model.

player_is_elite.summary: True when the player is using the Elite model.

player_is_editor.summary: True when the player is in Forge editor mode.

game_is_forge.summary: True when the current session is Forge (editor) mode.

game_options.summary: Declares built-in and user-defined game options (overrides, options, traits).

trigger.summary: Defines a trigger that runs conditions and actions for an event or phase.

variables.summary: Declares custom variables in a scope (global, team, player, or object).

base.summary: Declares that this script derives from a base Megalo script file.

include.summary: Includes another Megalo script file into this compilation unit.

localized_include.summary: Includes a locale-specific script fragment (strings / localization).

string_table.summary: Declares named string table entries used by HUD and messages.

hud_widgets.summary: Declares named HUD widgets and their screen positions.

loadout.summary: Defines a named loadout (weapons, equipment, grenades).

loadout_palette.summary: Groups loadout items into a selectable palette.

teams.summary: Configures multiplayer team options, models, and designators.

engine_data.summary: Sets engine-facing gametype metadata (name, description, icon, category).

map_permissions.summary: Restricts which maps this gametype may run on.

game_stats.summary: Declares custom scoreboard / end-of-round game statistics.

map_object.summary: Binds script metadata to a map object (label, type, team filter, …).

requisition_palette.summary: Defines a requisition (purchase) palette and its items.

action.summary: Introduces an action statement inside a trigger or begin block.

condition.summary: Introduces a condition that gates later statements in the trigger.

temporary.summary: Declares a temporary variable local to the current trigger block.

begin.summary: Opens a nested statement block that ends with a matching end.

end.summary: Closes the nearest open block (trigger, begin, element, …).

object.summary: Scope (`variables object`) or entry type (`… object <name> …`): one object-scoped copy / object reference.

end.summary: Closes the nearest open element or block.
Closes the nearest open element or block.

hide.summary: Hides a game option from the lobby UI.

override.summary: Overrides a built-in option or traits block with a scripted value.

option.summary: Declares a custom boolean/enum game option.

ranged_option.summary: Declares a custom numeric ranged game option.

player_traits.summary: Declares a named player_traits block used by overrides / apply_player_traits.

loadout_palette.summary: Built-in override: which loadout palette is active.

weapon_pickup.summary: Whether the player can pick up weapons.

drop_equipment.summary: Whether equipment is dropped on death.

vehicle_usage.summary: Which vehicles the player may enter.

double_jump.summary: Double-jump trait (MegaCrow extension): disabled, enabled, or triple.

gamertag_visibility.summary: When other players see this gamertag.

end.summary: Closes the nearest open element or block.

item.summary: Adds a loadout entry to this palette.

end.summary: Closes the nearest open element or block.

model.summary: Default / override player model for teams.

designator_switch_type.summary: How team designators switch during the match.

name.summary: Display name string for a team.

fireteam_count.summary: Number of fireteams on this team.

end.summary: Closes the nearest open element or block.
Closes the nearest open element or block.

show_in_scoreboard.summary: Whether rating is shown on the scoreboard.

end.summary: Closes the nearest open element or block.

exception.summary: Per-map exception to the default policy.

end.summary: Closes the nearest open element or block.
Closes the nearest open element or block.

label.summary: Filter / label string bound to this map object.

type.summary: Object type from the objects list.

team.summary: Team filter for this map object.
